reference.title: Quick Guide to the Tournament Director's Toolbar
reference.shortdesc: Here's what is available at each tab for a tournament director.

ul.li: Members - invite people, assign events, assign roles
Events/Score Counseling - view, audit, score, and lock events
Teams - add, view and edit teams and assign penalties
Results - view histograms, view scoresheet, view and present awards slideshow, view and print medals list, and export various scores
